title: Rename output columns with an alias
description: Write a query that returns every customer's `first_name` and `last_name`, with the columns renamed to `given_name` and `family_name` in the output.
hints: 💡 SQL concept to consider: AS (column alias)
column AS alias renames a column just in the query's result - it doesn't rename anything in the actual table.
Select first_name AS given_name and last_name AS family_name from customers.
expected_behavior: Returns first_name and last_name, labeled given_name and family_name.
solution: SELECT first_name AS given_name, last_name AS family_name FROM customers;
explanation: AS only affects how a column is labeled in the result set the client receives - the underlying table and its real column names are completely untouched.
